evidence.title: X2M sets up dedicated data center subsidiary and signs a deal for data center project

summary: X2M has created a new subsidiary focused exclusively on building and operating data‑center facilities, and the unit has already signed a contract to develop a major data‑center project. The move is intended to bolster the company’s AI computing capacity and support its expanding service portfolio.
title: X2M launches dedicated data‑center subsidiary and secures project deal
